primary_analysis: Confirmatory analysis executed under the paired_binary_analysis_v1 contract: exact paired binary test (McNemar exact or equivalent exact paired binomial) on the combined success flag (verifier AND simulator pass per episode). Report discordant-pair counts (guarded-only success, baseline-only success), absolute risk difference (guarded minus baseline) with 95% exact CI, and two-sided exact p-value. Apply preregistered 'complete_pair_primary' exclusion rule (exclude a task pair only if both condition executions for that task failed for infrastructure reasons). Inputs: execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/result_schema.json, execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/transformation_manifest.json.
secondary_analyses: per_fault_class_paired_success_rate_difference (exploratory): descriptive paired risk differences with CIs by fault class using task_manifest and raw_results.jsonl
residual_unsafe_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (exploratory): residual verifier/simulator failures after repair by condition

harmful_overrepair_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (exploratory): counts/proportions of repairs flagged by frozen harmful-change rules (protected-intent removals) by condition from transformation_manifest

model_call_cost_per_avoided_failure (exploratory): compute model-call counts and elapsed time per episode from execution_log.jsonl and model_configuration.json; estimate cost-per-avoided-failure with bootstrap CIs
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity: treat any technical/execution failure as a failed repair (zero) and recompute paired test and risk differences
verifier-only and simulator-only outcome tables: report analyses using verifier-only and simulator-only pass flags separately to show verifier↔simulator discordance effects (descriptive)
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: exact two-sided paired test p-value and 95% exact confidence interval for absolute paired risk difference. Report discordant counts and exact-binomial CIs where appropriate. For cost metrics use nonparametric bootstrap (archived model-call metadata and elapsed times) to produce 95% bootstrap CIs. Report exact sample sizes, excluded pairs (per complete_pair_primary) and number of technical failures.
multiplicity_implementation: Single predefined primary paired test (no multiplicity adjustment). All subgroup, per-fault-class, and secondary analyses are explicitly exploratory and reported as such; CIs provided but no confirmatory claims derived from exploratory analyses.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination procedures: deterministic string-match scanning of generated tasks/faults against the archived task bank (execution/task_manifest.jsonl) to detect overlap with public templates; report verifier vs simulator discordance (flag tasks where verifier passes and simulator fails and vice versa) using execution/raw_results.jsonl; audit repairs for protected-intent removals using execution/transformation_manifest.json. Primary success requires both verifier AND simulator agreement; all discordances and contamination flags reported descriptively in results and limitations.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Confirmatory paired outcome contingency: counts of (both pass, both fail, guarded-only pass, baseline-only pass) by task index; source: execution/raw_results.jsonl (paired_binary_episode_v1) and execution/result_schema.json

Table 2 — Discordant-pair breakdown: list of discordant task indices, fault class, guarded outcome, baseline outcome, and diagnostic traces; source: execution/raw_results.jsonl + execution/task_manifest.jsonl

Table 3 — Harmful-overrepair audit: counts and examples of repairs flagged by harmful-change rules (protected-intent removals), by condition and task index; source: execution/transformation_manifest.json

Table 4 — Model-call and latency summary: per-condition model-call counts, total tokens, elapsed wall-clock per episode, and aggregate cost; include bootstrap estimates of cost-per-avoided-failure; source: execution/execution_log.jsonl and execution/model_configuration.json
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Confirmatory pass rates by condition: bar chart with 95% exact CIs derived from Table 1 (execution/raw_results.jsonl)

Figure 2 — Discordant-pair visualization: scatter or dot chart of guarded-only vs baseline-only discordant task indices with fault-class color-coding (exploratory); source: execution/raw_results.jsonl + task_manifest
Figure 3 — Per-fault-class risk-difference forest plot (exploratory): paired risk differences with 95% CIs by fault class; source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and task_manifest
